title: lotus argophyllus subsp. niveus
intro: Lotus argophyllus subsp. niveus, commonly known as the Snow Lotus or Himalayan Lotus, is a plant species native to the high-altitude regions of the Himalayas and the Tibetan Plateau. This plant is prized for its unique snow-white flowers and medicinal properties, which have been used in traditional Tibetan medicine for centuries. The Snow Lotus is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the Snow Lotus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
